items.title: Dark agenda - month strip, magenta event pill and dated to-dos
items.description: A dark personal-agenda screen greeting 'Hi, Hamed' with a pink + FAB. A 'September 2026' week strip marks the 10th; under '08:00AM' a magenta event pill reads 'Google Meet with Mayo / 1hr 30m / Hamed & 2 others'. A '6 Tasks ToDo' header with Search and Share sits above dated task rows (Sept 20 Design Practice, Sept 30 Monthly Allowance, Oct 10 Group Excursion, Oct 20 Eye Inspection), each '1hr 30m'. The magenta pill is the only saturated element, so the next commitment owns the screen.

items.title: Dark neobank Money - balance, quick actions and a direct-deposit promo
items.description: A dark wallet 'Money' screen: 'Total Balance $4,361.78 / Your assets are safe', a four-up of quick actions (Deposit, Send, Request, Transfer), an 'Earnings' card (Lifetime $100.32, This month $26.96) beside an 'Activity' list (Dixcelr Sub -$19.00, Jaxon Slade +$19.57). A red 'Set Up Direct Deposit - get your paycheck early' card and two wallet tiles (InvFig $4,361.78, Extra $0) close it above a bottom nav. The red strip is a promo, not an alert.

items.title: Ulu Plus membership - benefits and the deposit-to-upgrade rule
items.description: A dark membership screen 'Ulu Plus Membership' in an orange-edged phone frame. Benefit rows: 'Free Transactions - use Ulu without paying Solana transaction fees' and 'Free Off-Ramps - off-ramp up to $30k/month to your bank without any fee'. A 'How to get Ulu Plus' block states 'Deposit $100+ into earn / keep $100 or more in earn to maintain your membership', closing on a white 'Deposit to upgrade' button. A crypto membership pitched as a balance threshold, not a fee.

items.title: Copperline photo capture - stage pills and a job photo strip
items.description: A dark camera screen in the HVAC field app: 'add photo' over a live view of a rooftop unit, with an overlay chip 'we'll file this as "during" the set' and a row of stage pills (before / during / ...). An 'on this job - 6 photos' thumbnail strip sits above a large shutter button and 'tap to shoot - hold for a burst'. The stage pills auto-file each photo into the job timeline, removing manual labelling.

items.title: Copperline team - technician roster with live job status pills
items.description: A dark 'Team' screen for 'Copperline - Friday Sep 11'. A 'Documented today 10/31' progress bar and 'Drafts waiting 3' sit above a roster: Diego Ramirez 'Panel - Gilbert' [Recording, red], Ana Soto 'Blower motor over limit' [Needs you, amber], Tre Walker 'Desert Oaks HOA Unit 7' [Reviewing, purple], Kyle Benson 'Driving - next 1:45' [4/4 done], Sam Ochoa 'Notes only 2 jobs today' [No capture]. A bottom nav (Today, Team, mic, Tasks, Alerts) closes it. Status pills colour-code each tech's moment.

items.title: Copperline insights - documented-vs-corrected bars across 7 techs
items.description: A dark 'Insights' screen: 'How Lepo is doing across your 7 techs' with Today/This week/Month/Techs chips. '118 jobs documented / 12 corrections' leads a mint-and-pink bar chart (Mon-Fri documented vs tech corrections). 'Where it paid' lists Invoice s 15 min 86%, Drafts accepted 91%, Facts corrected 7%; tiles report '$3,940 - 23 billable items' and '31 lb Refrigerant logged R-410A R-454B'. A footnote flags 'Sam captured 2 of 14 jobs'. A business-health view of the field app.

items.title: Copperline voice-fact review - waveform, transcript and confirm
items.description: A dark review sheet 'Where Lepo heard it' with a 'Fact' card - 'Run capacitor herm side measured 31.2 µF (rated 45/5 µF)' - above a two-colour audio waveform with play and 00:18/00:19. Transcript bubbles attribute the lines to Diego and Linda. Verification chips read 'Clear audio' and 'Matches photo caption' (green) plus 'Said once'. 'Correct' and 'Confirm' buttons close it with 'Wrong job? Move this to another job'. The screen lets a tech confirm an AI-extracted fact against its source audio.

items.title: Social profile - portrait over blurred photo, stats and interests
items.description: A dark social profile for 'Roselyn Archer / Paris, France': a circular portrait over a blurred photographic backdrop, a stats row (Followers 1,130 / Mutuals 6 / Age 27), 'Interests' chips (Movies, Cooking, Reading, Fitness, Travel), three round photo previews and a white 'Send a message' button. A back arrow and a more-menu float at the top. The blurred self-photo gives the profile warmth without a full hero image.

items.title: Genre Distribution widget - scattered pill bars with a legend
items.description: A dark rounded music widget titled 'Genre Distribution'. Scattered horizontal pill bars in blue, gold and mint of varying widths fill the field like a deconstructed chart; a legend row (Lo-fi, Pop, R&B, Others) with colour dots closes it. The pills encode share by width and colour without axes - a playful alternative to a pie chart.

items.title: AI Discovery widget - match score over a glowing arc wave
items.description: A dark gradient music widget 'AI Discovery': a large '24 tracks' figure on the left, 'AI Match 96%' on the right, above a delicate arc waveform of connected glowing dots in warm coral. The glow and the match percentage frame discovery as confidence, not just a list.

items.title: Listening Time widget - big hours with an album-art stack
items.description: A dark music widget 'Listening Time': '18h 42m' in large figures beside an overlapping stack of three album-art circles and a '+32' counter. A footer row reports 'Song Played 239' and 'Peak Time 9 PM-12 AM'. A compact stat widget that pairs one number with the visual identity of what was played.

items.title: Crypto wallet - total value hero with token portfolio list
items.description: A dark crypto wallet for 'X @wallet 2': 'Total Value $386,006.84 +1.46% (+$1,192.92)' with a green sparkline. A promo card pitches lower on-chain fees. 'Portfolio' tabs (All, Tokens, DeFi, Cash) sit above token rows - Bitcoin $751,158.75 (0.88 BTC), Ethereum $57,651.44, Solana $20,148.79, XRP $17,846.78 - each with price and change. A right rail of round tools and a blue + FAB close it. A night-mode portfolio that leads with total value and delta.

items.title: X-style social feed - dark posts with photo cards and a glass nav
items.description: A dark X/Twitter-style feed: top bar with avatar, X mark and bell; tabs For you / Following / Topics. Posts - Martin D 'Morning in Kyoto...' with two photo cards and #fyp #travel (43, 27, 900K), and Ballerina on photography - repeat down the view. A blue + FAB floats over a frosted-glass bottom nav (Home, Search, ...). The translucent nav over a photo is the standout detail.

items.title: Remittance home - USD balance, send/bank/cash and a transfers list
items.description: A dark remittance/neobank home 'YO / Earn $10' with a flag pair (UK -> Russia) above 'Total USD Balance $30.00'. Three round actions (send, bank, cash) sit over a 'Get 2% Cash back on transfers' banner. A 'Transactions' list shows Payment from Sarah Lee +$150 (Successful), Refund to Jake Smith -$50 (Failed), Transfer to Anna Wang -$75 (Pending). Bottom nav: Home, Payments, Cards, Lifestyle. Status chips colour the outcome of each transfer.

items.title: Parcel home - 'Three parcels, in motion' with an illustration hero
items.description: A light parcel-delivery home greeting 'Good morning, Olamide.' An 'IN TRANSIT' card headlines 'Three parcels, in motion' with a playful illustration of a figure packing a pink box, an ETA '15:34' and 'Ksi - 1.2km away'. Two tiles - 'New Shipment' and a black 'Live Tracking (2 Active Routes)' - sit above 'Recent Activities' (Sent Package Tobi - Ikeja, Delivered). A black pill nav marks Home active. The illustration makes logistics feel friendly.

items.title: Nigerian classifieds home - category circles, sale banner, trending ads
items.description: A light marketplace home 'Good Afternoon, Fatimah' with a 'Search for anything' field. Category circles (Phones, Vehicles, Fashion, Homes, See All) sit above a blue '50% Off Sales! Black Friday deals' banner featuring an iPhone. A 'Trending' list shows PS5 Pad ₦57,870 (Lagos) and 2 Bedroom Bungalow ₦1,345,000 (Abuja) with bookmark icons. Bottom nav with a blue + FAB. Prices in naira; a classic classifieds layout.

items.title: Restaurant checkout - delivery slot, order summary and GHS totals
items.description: A light 'Checkout' screen for a restaurant order. 'Delivery time 10:30-11:00 AM' offers Standard vs Schedule options. An 'Order Summary' card lists Skybar 25 items (Grilled sirloin steak x2, Chicken schnitzel x2, and more). A promo field with a green 'Promo Code' button precedes totals - Subtotal GHS 2,100, Delivery free, Taxes GHS 40, TOTAL GHS 2,140 - a 'Mobile Money' payment row and a green 'Place Order'. Currency is Ghanaian cedis.

items.title: Skybar cart - photo rows with green steppers and a sticky total
items.description: A light 'Cart' for 'Skybar 25': three rows - Grilled sirloin steak x2 GHS 700, Chicken schnitzel x2 GHS 150, Pan-seared salmon x1 GHS 400 - each with a food photo, a green +/- stepper and a trash affordance. A sticky foot shows 'Total Amount GHS 2,170' above a green 'Checkout' button. Clean cart pattern: photo, quantity, price on one line each.

items.title: Add Card - grouped card form in a light shell
items.description: A light 'Add Card' form: Card Number (visa), Exp. Date and CVV side by side, Billing Address ('Country or region'), and Nick Name (optional) prefilled 'Work card'. A full-width green 'Add Card' button pins the foot inside a device frame. A minimal, well-grouped payment form.

items.title: Multi-currency wallet - USD hero with GBP/EUR tiles and exchange
items.description: A dark multi-currency wallet 'Hello, Olamide / Dollar'. 'Total Balance $29,897.65' over an account number, then Send / Request / Convert buttons. Two tiles show 'GBP Balance £34,787.89' and 'EUR Balance €4,837.93'. 'RECENT ACTIVITIES' lists Martin Jude -$380 and two 'Received from Tolu +$49'. A 'Currency Exchange USD-EUR' row and a floating pill nav close it. The screen treats currencies as first-class balances.

items.title: Campus community home - class card, classmates and events
items.description: A dark campus-app home 'Good Morning, Nifemi'. A hero card reads 'Your official class community / Arts & Design 100 Level' with '218 Students' and '8 Active Now' chips and a yellow 'Review & Join' button. 'People in your class' shows avatar tiles (Beebah, Demola, Marlier - 8 Courses Shared). 'Happening on campus' lists event cards (XOXO 5.0 Oct 5th, Vibes 6.0 Oct 6th). Bottom nav: Home, Courses, Discover, Messages, Profile. A class-as-community hub.

items.title: Halcyon time-tracker - running timer over a project log
items.description: A dark time-tracking window 'Studio Sphere': a big running clock '1:35:32', a '25:32' pill and a 'Stop' button. Tabs Overview / Timeline / Projects sit above a 'Manual + Folder' row and a two-column project log - Boardly 2h 23m of 5h, Studio Sphere 2h 6m of 2h, Dream 24m of 1h30, SystemOS 30m, Amie 18m - closing on 'Next Halcyon check-in 06:56 PM'. A focused tracker that pairs one live timer with per-project budgets.

items.title: Halcyon time-tracker on an angled display - daily split and average
items.description: The same Halcyon tracker rendered on an angled monitor: 'Boardly 53:32' with Stop, tabs Overview/Timeline/Projects, a 'Today' stacked bar (5h 44m) and a project list with shares (Boardly 2h 22m 41%, Studio Sphere 2h 6m 37%, SystemOS 33m 10%, Dream 24m 7%, Amie 18m 5%). A 'Daily average 6h 8m +1% week on week' block shows mini stacked bars per weekday. The angled-device framing presents it as a desktop tool.

items.title: AI OS concept - gradient smart-home cards and a pink alarm stack
items.description: A design concept labelled 'AI OS / Slava Komikov / Version 2.0' showing two iPhone screens. Left 'Analytics': stacked translucent gradient cards for Moon, Weather 29°, Sleep, Light and Wind, each in its own hue. Right 'Screens': pink glassy alarm cards at 09:50 with a red 'Save' FAB. It is a speculative OS exploration of layered gradient cards, not a shipped product.
